The '''llaya''' was a creature that [[Homeworld/Legends|dwelled]] on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. Llayas threatened the herds of [[gamwidge]] farmers but could be driven by [[Tayan falcon]]s, a [[Bird/Legends|bird]] that shrieked and dive-bombed llayas. The falcon's methods of scaring away llayas were related to the concepts of pacifism and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] among Kinyen's native [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The llaya was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
